article.headline: No. 4 UConn tips off season at home against Gardner-Webb
article.description: Gardner-Webb Runnin' Bulldogs at UConn Huskies
article.story: Gardner-Webb Runnin' Bulldogs at UConn Huskies Hartford, Connecticut; Monday, 9 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: No. 4 UConn opens the season at home against Gardner-Webb. UConn went 15-2 at home a season ago while going 34-6 overall. The Huskies averaged 76.6 points per game last season, 12.7 on free throws and 24.9 from beyond the arc. Gardner-Webb went 4-29 overall last season while going 0-16 on the road. The Runnin' Bulldogs shot 42.8% from the field and 30.9% from 3-point range last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
